# ToonSwap

> ToonSwap is an original-character cartoon story and video-planning application. The current public product is a production-oriented foundation; it does not claim that every generative provider or all 200+ planned languages are live.

Canonical site: https://toonswap.vercel.app/
Sitemap: https://toonswap.vercel.app/sitemap.xml

## Public sections

- Home and guided quick creator: https://toonswap.vercel.app/
- 216 original character records: https://toonswap.vercel.app/characters
- Visual voice-direction library: https://toonswap.vercel.app/voices
- Six-step scene Story Studio: https://toonswap.vercel.app/story-studio
- Product and production roadmap: https://toonswap.vercel.app/roadmap
- Original storytelling guides: https://toonswap.vercel.app/blog
- Privacy: https://toonswap.vercel.app/privacy
- Terms: https://toonswap.vercel.app/terms
- Community guidelines: https://toonswap.vercel.app/community-guidelines

## Content and safety notes

- ToonSwap uses original characters and does not offer copies of famous copyrighted cartoon identities.
- Selfie and voice features require ownership or permission and are designed around consent and private media handling.
- Current catalog counts distinguish illustrated assets from structured blueprints.
- Language, voice, rendering, and long-form production capabilities marked as roadmap are not represented as live.
